quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, unlock the American gateway within the bedroom with the American key. After that, doublecheck that the American gateway within the bedroom is wide open. After pulling open the American gateway, make an effort to go west. With that accomplished, ensure that the wooden passageway inside the bedchamber is open. And then, take a trip west. Then, assure that the wooden hatch is ajar. After that, attempt to take a trip south. With that accomplished, venture south. After that, retrieve the grape from the floor of the austere workshop. Got that? Good!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, make it so that the American gateway within the bedroom is unlocked with the American key. And then, open the American gateway inside the bedroom. After that, try to go to the west. And then, open the wooden passageway within the bedchamber. And then, attempt to travel west. And then, open the wooden hatch inside the serious cubicle. Once you have pulled open the wooden hatch, venture south. If you can succeed at that, travel south. With that done, recover the grape from the floor of the austere workshop. And if you do that, you're the winner!
